description: CLWX-87 ASR WER bench fixture manifest. Each row is a known-speech clip: `text` is the reference transcript; synthetic rows are generated deterministically at bench time via macOS `say` (voice+rate pinned) or Windows System.Speech synthesis — no audio binaries in the repo. Rows with source `real` point at operator-supplied audio (`audioPath` relative to the manifest) for Trinidadian-accent coverage — the named gap synthetic TTS cannot cover.

clips.text: Good afternoon. Please prepare the daily report before three forty five this afternoon.
Student A was suspended for seven days following the incident in the Standard Four classroom.
The Ministry of Education circular requires all principals in the Victoria district to attend.
Parents in Couva and Chaguanas must sign the permission slip before the school tour.
The National School Code of Conduct defines irregular attendance as more than five days absent.
Please forward the suspension form to the district office in San Fernando by Friday.
The staff meeting minutes must record the decisions about the Infant One enrolment.
Teachers at the Tunapuna primary school reported a broken standpipe near the cafeteria.
